Copper alloy radiate of Quintillus (AD 270) (Reece Period 13), [CONCOR or similar? E]XERCI; Concordia standing left holding standard (or baton), and cornucopiae. Mint of Rome. RIC V, pt 2,- ; Cunetio - ; Normanby - . The reverse type is not recorded for the Mint of Rome, although the legend CONCOR / CONCORD EXER / EXERC is recorded (RIC V, pt 2, p. 240, nos. 10-11). The legend CONC / CONCO / CONCOR EXER / EXERC is recorded with this type at Milan (RIC V, pt 1, p. 243, nos. 45-6), but this coin has an obverse inscription for Rome.
